content:
I'd like to advertise PR #39100 (+363/-0). It proves a few technical statements, taken essentially straight from Bourbaki, which are crucial to show that multiple definitions of Fredholm operators are equivalent.

I'm quite proud of it because (1) I've written the proof in a way which seems more natural (to me) than the way it is written in Bourbaki, and (2) we're actually beating Bourbaki in generality! This will allow us to define Fredholm operators between TVSs over any complete docs#NontriviallyNormedField, so our theory will naturally include Fredholm operators over the p-adics.

Note finally that the proof is quite heavily commented, so hopefully you can follow, and maybe learn a thing or two :slight_smile:
A small algebraic argument has been split off as #41511, which should be quite easy to review. Apart form that, the main PR is ready for review again!
